name: Midway Circus
source:
Midway Circus is a visual novel horror game where you take place on the role of a Magician! As the player, you are going to explore the circus and meet this new family. Prepare to be scared and work your way to the end while discovering the secrets of this hellish circus.

[From [url=https://italotheartist.itch.io/midwaycircus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
中途岛马戏团是一款视觉小说恐怖游戏，你将扮演魔术师的角色！作为玩家，你将探索马戏团并结识这个新家庭。准备好害怕并努力走到最后，同时发现这个地狱马戏团的秘密。

[来自[url=https://italotheartist.itch.io/midwaycircus]Itch.io[/url]]
